headline: Europe's design and creative sector is in a split market: games are consolidating and cutting jobs, including the proposed closure of Ubisoft's Finnish RedLynx studio, while EU textile-circularity rules and Horizon creative-economy calls are creating new openings for research-based ventures.
outlook_reason: Games funding and jobs are under pressure and venture money is concentrating in AI and dev tools, but EU textile EPR, circularity and creative-economy programmes give university spin-offs policy and grant tailwinds.

metrics.label: Finnish games industry turnover
metrics.value: about €2.85 bn; about 4,300 staff; 270 active studios (latest full report)

metrics.label: Finnish games industry 2025 revenue
metrics.value: Neogames' preliminary estimate says revenue grew; no euro figure found

metrics.value: €363.3 bn (1.47% of the business economy); value added €146.6 bn (2.26%)

metrics.value: €7.08 bn (1.79% of business economy); value added €3.0 bn (2.88%)

metrics.label: Global gaming M&A and private funding, Q3
metrics.value: M&A $2.4 bn over 45 deals; private funding $1.6 bn+ over 106 rounds, more than 80% to AI and dev tools (secondary source, unverified)

signals.title: Ubisoft proposes closing Finnish studio RedLynx
signals.detail: Ubisoft issued notices for the proposed closure of RedLynx (up to 52 positions) and cut about 70 roles in Singapore. Figures come from an aggregator.

signals.title: More European studio closures and restructurings
signals.detail: Liquid Swords is closing, DON'T NOD is under court protection (up to 85 jobs at risk), and Supermassive cut more than 70 jobs. Aggregator report, to be verified.

signals.title: Horizon call on textile circularity opens (Textiles for the Future)
signals.detail: HORIZON-CL4-2027-01-MAT-PROD-08 is an Innovation Action call on advanced processing and manufacturing for textile circularity, due 2027-02-02.

signals.title: CREA news and media calls open
signals.detail: CREA calls on journalism partnerships, media literacy and media freedom open, with deadlines from 2027-01-20 to 2027-02-04.

signals.title: Textile EPR fact sheet published; national transposition ahead
signals.detail: The revised Waste Framework Directive entered into force on 2025-10-16. Member states must transpose it by June 2027, and schemes are due by April 2028 (sources differ on the exact dates). Brands will pay eco-modulated fees based on durability and recyclability.

signals.title: Neogames outlook: 2026 expected to be strong, funding tight
signals.detail: Neogames expects a strong 2026, citing releases such as Housemarque's Saros and Remedy's Control Resonant. Venture capital and public innovation funding for mobile studios are limited, and 75 new startups were founded in three years.
